 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R

The petitioner, who is a lady and has got two minor children, is apprehending arrest in a case Khushi Dutta vs The State Of Haryana on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2774027/
1 punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Khushi Dutta vs The State Of Haryana on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The main accused is her husband,
who is presently absconding.

Considering that she has got two minor children and nothing has been shown to us that the petitioner is not cooperating in the ongoing investigation, we do not think that this is a case where custodial interrogation of the petitioner is required.
But this would not mean that the petitioner will stop cooperating with the ongoing investigation.
The petitioner shall respond to the Investigating Officer and shall visit the Police Station as and when she is required.
However, under the circumstances, we are of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled for an anticipatory bail.

In the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with FIR No. 1573 dated 26.12.2023 registered at Police Station Panipat City, District Panipat, she shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.

entities.text: Police Station Panipat City, District Panipat

sentences.text: In view of above, the Special leave Petition is disposed of.
Pending interlocutory application(s)
is/are disposed of.

(JAYANT KUMAR ARORA) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
